metadata.name: Hi-C_fastqToCool_hicup_c (release v0.2)
annotations: This workflow takes as input a collection of paired fastq. It uses HiCUP to go from fastq to validPair file using the middle of the fragment as coordinates. The pairs are filtered for MAPQ and sorted by cooler to generate a tabix dataset. Cooler is used to generate a balanced cool file to the desired resolution.
